narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Seven and four make eleven, so write one and drop the extra one.
<bookmark mark='carry'/>That extra one is ten tens, so it belongs in the next column.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Dropping it loses a whole place value. It must be carried to the left.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 7 + 4 = 11, write 1, with the second 1 crossed out; an arrow from the crossed 1 to the next column flashes; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Times eleven adds each digit to its neighbour, from the right, carrying when needed.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find two thousand three hundred forty one times eleven, in one line.
